description: MCP server for Pipedrive CRM. 155 contract-tested tools, v2-first API, gated destructive ops. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and any MCP client.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_add_deal_discount
tool_signatures.description: Add an additional discount to a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_add_deal_follower
tool_signatures.description: Add a follower to a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_add_deal_installment
tool_signatures.description: Add an installment (payment schedule entry) to a deal. Growth+ plan required; the deal must have at least one one-time product and no recurring products.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_add_deal_product
tool_signatures.description: Attach a single product as a line item to a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_bulk_add_deal_products
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-add up to 100 line-item products to a deal in one request.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_convert_deal_to_lead
tool_signatures.description: Convert a deal to a lead (async job). DESTRUCTIVE: a successful conversion marks the source deal as deleted. Returns a conversion_id; the conversion runs asynchronously, so you MUST poll pipedrive_get_deal_conversion_status with the conversion_id until a terminal status. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_activity
tool_signatures.description: Create a new activity in Pipedrive. Subject and type are required.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_board
tool_signatures.description: Create a new project board. name is required. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_deal
tool_signatures.description: Create a new deal in Pipedrive. Only title is required; all other fields are optional.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_deal_field
tool_signatures.description: Create a deal custom field. field_name and field_type are required. For enum/set types, options is required. The response data.field_code is the 40-char hash you must keep to update or delete the field later.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_organization_field
tool_signatures.description: Create an organization custom field. field_name and field_type are required. For enum/set types, options is required. The response data.field_code is the 40-char hash to keep for later updates.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_person_field
tool_signatures.description: Create a person custom field. field_name and field_type are required. For enum/set types, options is required. The response data.field_code is the 40-char hash to keep for later updates.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_phase
tool_signatures.description: Create a new project phase. name and board_id are required. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_create_product_field
tool_signatures.description: Create a product custom field. field_name and field_type are required. For enum/set types, options is required. Product fields use a simpler model: no description, important_fields, or required_fields. The response data.field_code is the 40-char hash to keep for later updates.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_activity
tool_signatures.description: Delete an activity.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_board
tool_signatures.description: Delete a project board. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true). (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal
tool_signatures.description: Delete a deal. The deal will be marked as deleted and permanently removed after 30 days.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_discount
tool_signatures.description: Delete an additional discount from a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_field
tool_signatures.description: Delete a deal custom field by field_code. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete options of a deal enum/set field. Atomic: fails if any ID does not exist. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_follower
tool_signatures.description: Remove a follower from a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_installment
tool_signatures.description: Delete an installment from a deal. Growth+ plan required.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_deal_product
tool_signatures.description: Remove a line-item product from a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_organization_field
tool_signatures.description: Delete an organization custom field by field_code. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_organization_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete options of an organization enum/set field. Atomic: fails if any ID does not exist. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_person_field
tool_signatures.description: Delete a person custom field by field_code. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_person_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete options of a person enum/set field. Atomic: fails if any ID does not exist. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_phase
tool_signatures.description: Delete a project phase. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true). (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_product_field
tool_signatures.description: Delete a product custom field by field_code. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_delete_product_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete options of a product enum/set field. Atomic: fails if any ID does not exist. Requires PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full (back-compat: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=true).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_activity
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific activity by ID.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_board
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific project board by ID. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_deal
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific deal by ID, including all standard and custom fields.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_deal_conversion_status
tool_signatures.description: Get the status of a deal-to-lead conversion job. Status contract:

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_deal_followers_changelog
tool_signatures.description: Get the followers changelog for a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_field
tool_signatures.description: Get details of a specific field by its key. Useful for looking up what a 40-character hash field key means.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_get_phase
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific project phase by ID. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_activities
tool_signatures.description: List activities from Pipedrive with optional filtering by owner, deal, person, organization, type, or completion status.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_archived_deals
tool_signatures.description: List archived deals with the same filtering as the active deals list (owner, person, organization, pipeline, stage, status). Returns paginated results.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_boards
tool_signatures.description: List all project boards. Returns the complete list (no pagination — the boards endpoint returns all records at once). (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deal_discounts
tool_signatures.description: List all additional discounts applied to a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deal_fields
tool_signatures.description: List all deal field definitions, including custom fields. Essential for understanding deal data structure.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deal_followers
tool_signatures.description: List all followers for a deal.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deal_installments
tool_signatures.description: List installments across one or more deals. Requires deal_ids. Growth+ plan required.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deal_products
tool_signatures.description: List line-item products attached to a deal. Returns paginated results.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_deals
tool_signatures.description: List deals from Pipedrive with optional filtering by owner, person, organization, pipeline, stage, or status. Returns paginated results.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_organization_fields
tool_signatures.description: List all organization field definitions, including custom fields. Use this to map 40-character field keys to human-readable names.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_person_fields
tool_signatures.description: List all person field definitions, including custom fields. Use to understand contact data structure.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_phases
tool_signatures.description: List all phases for a project board. board_id is required. Returns the complete list (no pagination — the phases endpoint returns all records for a board at once). (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_product_fields
tool_signatures.description: List all product field definitions, including custom fields.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_list_project_fields
tool_signatures.description: List all project field definitions, including custom fields. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_search_deals
tool_signatures.description: Search for deals by text in title. Supports fuzzy matching by default.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_activity
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing activity in Pipedrive. Use this to mark activities as done.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_board
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing project board. Only id is required; all other fields are optional. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing deal in Pipedrive. Specify the deal ID and any fields to update.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal_discount
tool_signatures.description: Update an additional discount on a deal. All fields except IDs are optional.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal_field
tool_signatures.description: Update a deal custom field by field_code. field_type and field_code cannot be changed.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update option labels of a deal enum/set field. Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal_installment
tool_signatures.description: Update an installment on a deal. Growth+ plan required; all body fields optional.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_deal_product
tool_signatures.description: Update a line-item product attached to a deal. All body fields optional.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_organization_field
tool_signatures.description: Update an organization custom field by field_code. field_type and field_code cannot be changed.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_organization_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update option labels of an organization enum/set field. Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_person_field
tool_signatures.description: Update a person custom field by field_code. field_type and field_code cannot be changed.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_person_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update option labels of a person enum/set field. Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_phase
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing project phase. Only id is required; all other fields are optional. Set board_id to move this phase to a different board. (Projects add-on; Projects API in public beta.)

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_product_field
tool_signatures.description: Update a product custom field by field_code. Only field_name and ui_visibility can be changed (product fields have no description/important_fields/required_fields).

tool_signatures.name: pipedrive_update_product_field_options
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update option labels of a product enum/set field. Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.
